description: WP-PLT-WORKFLOW-TEMPLATES-01 — the product-identity approval definitions MDM starts through Platform's trusted start (TrustedWorkflowStartAuthorization). One stage, one approval step, no assignment: the candidates MDM sends decide who approves. Installed by the --ensure-workflow-templates command, never at start-up. MDM-COMP-PROPOSAL and the CRM claim flows are not here (tenant-specific definitions).

templates.name: Global product identity approval
templates.description: Approves a global product's identity (MDM, object type GlobalProduct).

templates.name: GSKU identity approval
templates.description: Approves a global SKU's identity (MDM, object type gsku).

templates.name: GSKU correction approval
templates.description: Approves a correction to an approved global SKU (MDM, object type GskuCorrection).

templates.name: GSKU retirement approval
templates.description: Approves a global SKU retirement request (MDM, object type GskuRetirementRequest).

templates.name: LSKU identity approval
templates.description: Approves a local SKU's identity (MDM, object type lsku).

templates.name: LSKU retirement approval
templates.description: Approves a local SKU retirement request (MDM, object type LskuRetirementRequest).

templates.name: Item activation approval
templates.description: Approves an item's activation (MDM, object type Item).
